main_text.l: Hactenus de Titulo primo; sequitur Secundus.
Vt partes, alioqui dissolutas, in Methodum reducam; agitur de Pontificio Iure Vniuersali in Laicos;
De Officio Pastoratus Pontificij vniuersali, praesertim su-

marginalia.note: Principes} Catholicos suos; quos Arietes indigitat.
“ Alterum officium significatur in nomine Pastoris, cuius est pascere, & alere filios jamnatos. &c. Pag.27.

page.notes: The bracket structure is hard to read: it is not clear which boxes sit under the brace after "alioqui" and which under the brace after "Laicos;". The levels given are my reading of the depth of the braces. The diagram continues below the cut, so the last box may be incomplete. The running head "Cap.2." at the right is a chapter marker and is not part of the running title. The right-margin bracket annotation runs down from the top of this part into the printed text beside it; its paragraph is not visible here. The left-margin note is printed in italic with quotation marks at the start of each line; the second line begins with a mark that may be a duplicate quote. "iamnatos" is printed with i, transcribed as jamnatos per the consonant-j rule. The catchword "I. ANI-" is at the lower right.
